title: My first machine learning class
text: In 2016, I took my first machine learning class during my Telecommunications Engineering degree at UAM. In 2018, I put it into practice in my bachelor’s thesis on voice activity detection using neural networks.
alt: Cover of Patricia’s bachelor’s thesis on voice activity detection using neural networks, July 2018
caption: My bachelor’s thesis · July 2018.

title: Programming at Ciber
text: I joined Ciber as an Android development intern in October 2017 and stayed on as an Android developer from April 2018 to October 2019. I love programming, and I really enjoyed working in a company. Ciber is now part of Experis.
caption: Experis · Current company branding.

title: From UAM to UPM
text: After my BSc at UAM, I moved to UPM for the MSc in Telecommunications Engineering, specialising in Machine Learning and Multimedia Data Science. With my first research contract at GATV, I worked on deepfakes: transferring facial gestures and generating video from audio-visual information.
alt: An example from Patricia’s facial gesture transfer research showing an input portrait, facial landmarks and a generated face
caption: Facial gesture transfer experiments · Master’s research, 2019–2020.

title: Consultancy at MS
text: I returned to consultancy at Management Solutions from September 2020 to January 2021, developing data tools for financial risk monitoring and management. In the meantime, I kept looking for a role related to AI.
caption: Management Solutions · 2020–2021.

title: Back to UPM
text: On 18 January 2021, I joined GAPS as a predoctoral researcher and began my PhD in Communications Technologies and Systems. My research focused on generative models, survival analysis and synthetic data in healthcare.
alt: Patricia with the GAPS group outside ETSIT at UPM
caption: With the GAPS group at UPM.

title: Three months in Copenhagen
text: I joined Anders Krogh’s group at the Center for Health Data Science to work on optimisation techniques for generative models.
alt: Members of the HeaDS group together in Copenhagen
caption: With the HeaDS group in Copenhagen.

title: PhD defended!
text: I defended my thesis, Deep Generative Models for Survival Analysis and Synthetic Data Generation in Healthcare, supervised by Juan Parras Moral.
alt: Patricia with GAPS members on the day of her PhD defense
caption: With GAPS on the day of my defense.

title: AI meets batteries
text: A 6.5-month research stay at ICV-CSIC, working with Nataly Carolina Rosero Navarro’s group on battery design and diagnostics.
place: Institute of Ceramics and Glass · CSIC
alt: Research group at the Institute of Ceramics and Glass
caption: With the group at ICV-CSIC.

title: Back at UAM
text: On 11 June 2026, I joined EPS-UAM as an Assistant Professor (Ayudante Doctora) in the AUDIAS group, while continuing my research collaboration with GAPS-UPM.
alt: Patricia with members of the AUDIAS group outdoors at UAM
caption: With the AUDIAS group · 2026.
